take_homes: split only on access, dialect or stance, otherwise one agent with a good prompt
give the synthesizer a framework like Rumelt's kernel so it picks one answer instead of averaging three
the weak spot is the handoff between agents, so check that points like two numbers don't collapse into one
'do' vs 'propose' and the file vs another-system boundary are good ways to scope what an agent may do
